relation.note: His brother Jānam, the grand amīr akhūr (master of the stables); the office belongs to the brother, not to the headword. No independent biography of this Jānam was located in the corpus (the جانم entries D02389–D02397 do not match, and none of the corpus's amīr akhūr kabīr holders is named Jānam), so a relation-only person ID is used.

person.note: イーナール・バーイ、大アミール・アーホール（アミール・アーホール・カビール、厩舎長官）のジャーナムの兄弟。841年ズー・アル＝カアダ月に死去した。彼は立派な人物であった。
Īnāl Bāy, the brother of Jānam, the grand amīr akhūr (master of the stables). He died in Dhū al-Qaʿda in the year 841 H. He was a good man.
